headline: Giba climbs 101 places on ARC-2, from 196th to 95th

sections.text: Giba climbed 101 places, moving from 196th to 95th at 34.44, a gain of 2.08 on the ARC-AGI-2 public board.
The jump brings the team into the top 100 of the public board. The gold line stands at 66.53, and the public standings are provisional while medals are decided on the private board.

sources.title: ARC-AGI-2 public leaderboard: saved board and the past day's changes
